topics.title: NIST Incident Response Lifecycle
topics.summary: Standard 4-phase framework covering Preparation, Detection & Analysis, Containment, Eradication & Recovery, and Post-Incident Activity.
bullets: Preparation: Establish IR plan, communication channels, and tooling.
Detection & Analysis: Monitor telemetry, triage alerts, and determine scope.
Containment, Eradication & Recovery: Isolate hosts, remove persistence, and restore services.
Post-Incident: Conduct lessons learned and update detection rules.
